messages:
ops-bot: [ALERT] 2026-06-12T14:01:08Z — Elevated 5xx rate observed from eu-west kvcache reads. Affected: hosted text-gen endpoints using long-prefix caching. Automatic uncached fallback enabled. Tracking: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/1732102468 :rotating_light:

Hana (oncall): Investigating. Grafana shows a sharp spike in read latency and IO wait on a subset of cache nodes. Appears correlated with a small set of hot prefix keys causing uneven shard load.

Vik (eng-sre): Logs show repeated "read_timeout / io_queue_full" for replica-set rs-7. Snippet:
```
[2026-06-12T13:59:52Z] kvcache.rs-7: read_timeout: queue_len=256 max=250
[2026-06-12T14:00:03Z] kvcache.rs-7: io_error: writeback delayed
```

Priya (support): Notifying customers on the high-throughput list. Draft: "We're seeing increased latency and occasional 5xx from eu-west cache tier for some workloads. Fallbacks are enabled; requests succeed but may be slower. Our team is actively mitigating." Sending to Tier A now.

Markus (infra): Immediate mitigation: enabling per-key read throttling and triggering a rebalance to spread hot prefixes across more shards. Also provisioning two extra cache nodes (c6_large) to relieve IO. ETA for rebalance ~7m.

Jenna (product): Confirm whether Dedicated/reserved customers are impacted so messaging is accurate.

Hana (oncall): Dedicated and private deployments unaffected; issue is confined to the multi-tenant eu-west cache ring. Fallback path preserves correctness.

ops-bot: Update 14:07Z — per-key throttling active, rebalance started, new nodes provisioning. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/kv-cache/eu-west?orgId=1

Vik (eng-sre): After throttling and rebalance start, 5xx rate dropped from 4.7% -> 1.1%. Still seeing periodic spikes tied to the same hot prefix set. Collecting heap and IO metrics for those nodes.

Priya (support): Posted public status: "Partial degradation in eu-west; fallbacks active. No data loss. We will update when stabilized." Pushed to #support-updates and updated status page.

Markus (infra): Rebalance completed, additional replicas healthy. Running a short eviction pass and increasing async IO workers on the affected hosts.

Vik (eng-sre): Error rate now 0.12% over 10m window. Tail latency reduced but still ~80ms above baseline for affected prefixes. Keeping throttles for another 5m to observe.

Hana (oncall): Postmortem leads: Vik + Markus. Capture: root cause likely insufficient hashing granularity for long-prefix patterns combined with a client query pattern that concentrated lookups. Action items: improve hot-key detection, add adaptive rehashing, and update routing heuristics.

Jenna (product): I'll draft a customer-facing summary once we confirm stable and have RCA timeline.

ops-bot: Update 14:13Z — criteria met for close: error rate <0.2% for 10m and tail latency trending down. Final: fallbacks handled correctness, no customer data lost, targeted customers notified. Closing incident soon. :white_check_mark:
